suite_name: DuoMath retrieval golden set (R0 baseline, R2 expectation model, R5 bank growth)
description: Queries with what a correct retriever should surface. Written for backend/tests/eval_rag.py, which scores Recall@k / MRR / nDCG / latency offline, in either sparse (R0) or hybrid (R2) mode. v3 (R5) keeps Q01-Q16 unchanged and adds Q17-Q48 for the 53 worked examples and 14 concept nodes added in R5, including four adversarial off-topic controls.
notes: expected_ids refer to backend/data/math_problems.jsonl (p1..p59) when expected_source is 'examples'.
expected_ids refer to node ids in backend/data/math_concepts.json when expected_source is 'concepts'.
expect=must_find   -> scored for recall against expected_ids.

expect=no_examples -> on-topic but absent from the worked-example bank: returning a worked example is a false positive unless its id is listed in allowed_ids (an on-topic neighbour); concepts are correct, and expected_ids names the ones that should appear.
expect=nothing     -> off-topic: returning anything at all is a false positive.
Version 2.0 splits v1's single 'control' kind in two, because a multi-source retriever makes them different obligations.

Version 3.0 (R5): the bank grew 6 -> 59 rows. Q15 gained allowed_ids [p44, p45] because the bank now contains two honest integral problems; an adjacent integral is on-topic, an unrelated inequality (what the 6-row guard let through at 59 rows) is not. The four new controls are deliberately built from words a maths bank is full of ('chứng minh', 'tìm', 'đường', 'phương').
